name: Doncaster
appliesTo: City of Doncaster Council (CDC) is responsible for determining the holiday pattern for community primary schools, community special schools and Pupil Referral Units within the City.
academyNote: Academies, Free Schools and Church Schools will set their own dates and are encouraged to set the same or similar dates. For Academies and Church Schools - please check with the School.

localFacts.fact: Doncaster's holiday pattern covers community primary schools, community special schools and Pupil Referral Units; academies, free schools and church schools set their own dates.
In spring 2026 the council consulted on two draft versions of the 2027-28 calendar, with a closing date of 24 April 2026.

Version 1 of the 2027-28 draft follows a common holiday pattern agreed with the 3 other South Yorkshire councils; Version 2 starts on the first Monday in September and finishes later in the summer term.
For 2026-27 the council lists the May bank holiday as a one-day closure: schools close on Monday 3 May and reopen on Tuesday 4 May 2027.
There are five training days to be arranged by schools each year.
The 2026-27 Easter holiday starts on Good Friday, 26 March 2027, and schools reopen on Monday 12 April 2027.

2026-27.insetNote: Please note: There are five training days to be arranged.
2026-27.notes: The live council site returns 403 to automated readers; dates read from the Wayback Machine copy of 24 April 2026 (page last updated 15 April 2026). Summer holiday starts Thursday 22 July 2027; the 2027-28 start date was not decided on that copy.

2027-28.notes: On the latest readable copy (24 April 2026) the council was seeking views on two draft 2027-28 school holiday patterns (V1 and V2), closing date 24 April 2026. No determined 2027-28 dates could be read: the live page is blocked (403) and no later archive copy exists.
